name: edit_scene
description: Edit the scene module with exact replacements: put every change of the turn in this one call, one entry per change. The entries apply in order, each to the result of the previous one; each oldString is exact literal text, including all whitespace, indentation and newlines, with enough surrounding lines that it matches one location only. The entries apply together or not at all: when one does not match, none is applied and the error names it. With fromRevision, the entries start from that earlier revision's code instead of the current scene, so one call brings back a better revision and fixes it. A successful call creates one revision and returns its id. {{snippets}}

edits.description: Every change of the turn, one entry per change, in the order they apply.

oldString.description: The exact literal text to replace, including whitespace, indentation and newlines. It must match exactly one location in the scene as the earlier edits of this call left it.

newString.description: The exact literal text that replaces oldString.

fromRevision.description: Id of an earlier revision to start from instead of the current scene, e.g. r1. Omit to edit the current scene.
